stem:
A beaker of water which has reached boiling point is allowed to cool. The temperature of the water is recorded at five minute intervals, and a temperature-time graph is drawn.

Cooling Curve

[Image: Graph of cooling curve]

About how many minutes did it take for the water to cool the first 20 degrees?
figure_description: A line graph titled "Cooling Curve" on a grid. The vertical axis is labeled "Temperature (°C)" with grid lines and numerical labels from 20 to 100 in increments of 20 (20, 40, 60, 80, 100), with 0 at the origin. The horizontal axis is labeled "Time (minutes)" with grid lines and numerical labels from 0 to 50 in increments of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50). A smooth curve starts at (0, 100) and decreases monotonically toward the right, passing through approximately (5, 74), (10, 55), (15, 43), (20, 37), (25, 32), (30, 28), (35, 24), (40, 22), (45, 21), and ending at (50, 20).
